findings.observation: The actual previews show low-poly green tree crowns close behind the hard-surface cars. This is a separate, common environment style rather than a car-specific rendering artifact. The implementation intentionally builds the crowns from low-detail icosahedra and assigns a flat-shaded material, which explains the broad triangular color facets visible in the screenshots. The screen evidence does not show that these facets cause gameplay or clipping problems; the issue is the visual contrast with the imported car surfaces.
